FULL TEXT:
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
Department of Public Administration
University Business School
WALK-IN INTERVIEW ON 6TH NOVEMBER, 2026
Recruitment of short-term research staff
For the projects funded by Climate Compatible Growth Project (CCG), Center for
Global Equality, Cambridge, U.K.
Project I: Transport Decarbonisation,
Distributional Incidence and Policy Durability:
Evidence and Policy Learning from Chandigarh’s
EV Registration Quota
PI: Prof. Suveera Gill, University Business
School, <suveera@pu.ac.in>
Research Assistant/Junior Research
Fellow – 1 (upto80 days)
Interns – 2 (upto total of 24 days)
Project II: Taking forward EV Transition
Studies: OSeMOSYS for Sustainable Energy
Planning at the City level; Political Economy of
Public Policy for Sustainable Development
PI: Dr. Bhawna Gupta, Department of Public
Administration, <bhawnag@pu.ac.in>
Research Associate (Post-Doc Level)
– 1 (upto 100 days)
Research Assistant/Junior Research
Fellow – 1 (upto 120 days)
Interns – 3 (total 45 days)
Note: The number of days and the dates for which research staff will actually be employed
is at the discretion of the PI. Payment will be on per day basis @ Rs.1500/Rs. 1200/ Rs.
500 per day for Research Associate, Research Fellow and Intern respectively
Required Qualifications:
• Research Associate: PhD in Science/Social Science with Environment Specialisation.
Knowledge of OSeMOSYS & CLEWS required.
• Research Fellow: Masters in Public Administration/ Management/Commerce
Position for Project II requires knowledge of OSeMOSYS & CLEWS
• Intern: Masters (completed or ongoing) in Public Administration/Management/
Commerce
Reporting Date and Time: Friday, 06 November 2026 at 1:00PM
Reporting Venue: Class Room No. 3, Department of Public Administration, First Floor,
Arts Block 3, Sector 14, Panjab University, Chandigarh 160014.
Application Procedure
1. All interested candidates may appear for the Walk-In-Interview at the venue
mentioned above at the specified time, along with the duly filled application form
available below.
2. The duly filled application form must be submitted at the time of reporting by 01.00
p.m. on Friday, 06 November, 2026.
3. Incomplete application forms and applications that are not in provided format may
be summarily rejected.
4. Candidates should ensure that the information mentioned in the application form is
accurate. Once the application form is submitted, no further requests for changes
will be considered.
5. The candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying for the positions, as
ineligible candidates will not be interviewed.
6. All candidates are requested to appear for the Walk-In-Interview with the
application form, experience certificates, publications and original degree
certificates and transcripts.
7. Any experience, publications or technical skills claimed in the application should be
supported by documentary evidence, wherever applicable.
8. The University may verify eligibility and original documents before finalising
selection.
9. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
10. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify
the candidate.
11. The posts are purely on a temporary basis.
For any queries contact:
1. Prof. Suveera Gill – suveera@pu.ac.in
2. Dr. Bhawna Gupta – bhawnag@pu.ac.in
